steps.title: Stack centre tanks hold bosses centred
steps.rule: Stand at the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 6m east of the centre.

steps.title: Stack centre
steps.rule: Stand at the centre.

steps.title: Take the tether
steps.cue: A tether lands on another player
steps.rule: Walk into the beam between the black hole and whoever holds it; the tether jumps to you.

steps.title: Take the tether again
steps.rule: Someone walked through the beam and took it: walk back into the line between the black hole and its holder.

steps.title: Pull the hole
steps.rule: Walk the tether to the cardinal clockwise of the black hole, a step further out, so the hole follows you away from the centre.
